_note: Professional accessible description (AD) for the PurelandFold 'heart' design, mapped to PurelandFold steps. Used to score how describe.py groups program steps into AD steps. Step summaries are our paraphrases; the original text stays on the source page (non-commercial use only), so it is not copied here.

ad_steps.summary: Lay the square as a diamond.
Left point to right point, crease, unfold.
Top point to bottom point, crease, unfold.
Top point down to the centre.
Bottom point up to the top edge.
Bottom left and right edges to the centre crease.
Fold back top points and side corners (no turning over).

grouping_rules: A fold followed by its unfold is one step.
Finishing folds are one step; 'fold back' replaces turning the paper over.
order_note: Her steps 2 and 3 make the two diagonal creases in the opposite order to PurelandFold (PurelandFold folds top-to-bottom first).

website_photos._note: origamiway.com step photo number -> PurelandFold step. PurelandFold 6 (rotation), 13 and 15 (one half of a symmetric pair) have no photo.
